meta.title: Da Nang Beach Update January 2026 🌊 | Weather, Vibe Check & Current Conditions
meta.description:
In today’s walking and talking tour, I explore the An Thuong area of Da Nang, checking out the current weather and giving a fresh update on new bars, restaurants, and the overall vibe of this popular tourist neighborhood. As we walk through the streets, I share how the area feels right now, what’s changed recently, and what’s new for visitors and expats.
This video is perfect if you’re planning a trip to Da Nang, staying near My An or My Khe Beach, or just want a real-time update on An Thuong’s food, nightlife, and street atmosphere. A relaxed walk, honest impressions, and a look at how the neighborhood is developing.
📍 In this video:
– An Thuong walking & talking tour
– Da Nang weather update
– New bars and restaurants
– Tourist area & expat vibes
– Real street life in Da Nang
